== Ingredients ==
* 2 slabs St. Louis style/cut [[Cookbook:Pork|pork]] spareribs
* 6 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Barbecue Rub|Barbecue Rub]]
* 2 tbsp [[Cookbook:Mincing|minced]] fresh [[Cookbook:Ginger|ginger]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Peach|peach]] preserves
* 2 tbsp [[Cookbook:Worcestershire Sauce|Worcestershire sauce]]
* 2 tbsp [[Cookbook:Cider Vinegar|cider vinegar]]
* Dry applewood chunks

== Procedure ==
#Season ribs with the Barbecue Rub. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
#Place applewood in the firebox of a 250°F [[Cookbook:Smoker|smoker]] or in the coal area of a 250°F charcoal [[Cookbook:Grilling|grill]] set for indirect heat.
#Combine remaining ingredients and bring to a [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]] over high heat until reduced by ⅓. Cover tightly and set aside.
#Place ribs in smoker/on top of grill grate and cook, [[Cookbook:Brush|brushing]] often with preserve mixture, for 5–6 hours.
#Brush ribs generously with preserve mixture and place on a medium high grill and cook, repeatedly brushing side facing you, until well browned. Repeat one more time.
#Remove and let rest 10 minutes; slice into 1-rib portions and serve.

steps.text: Season ribs with the Barbecue Rub. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
Place applewood in the firebox of a 250°F smoker or in the coal area of a 250°F charcoal grill set for indirect heat.
Combine remaining ingredients and bring to a boil over high heat until reduced by ⅓. Cover tightly and set aside.
Place ribs in smoker/on top of grill grate and cook, brushing often with preserve mixture, for 5–6 hours.
Brush ribs generously with preserve mixture and place on a medium high grill and cook, repeatedly brushing side facing you, until well browned. Repeat one more time.
Remove and let rest 10 minutes; slice into 1-rib portions and serve.
